subject.title: feat(webui): reintroduce opt-in AI purpose titles for tool calls

question: Should OpenClaw permanently add a core gateway setting and model-backed RPC for optional decorative Control UI tool-call titles?
rationale: The change adds config, protocol, provider routing, token spend, and persisted cache behavior for an optional presentation feature; implementation review cannot determine that product boundary.

options.title: Ship the opt-in core feature
options.body: Accept the permanent surface after all correctness blockers, upgrade proof, and real behavior proof are complete.

options.title: Keep deterministic core rendering
options.body: Decline the model-backed title path and retain the current deterministic tool activity UI.

recommendation.title: Ship the opt-in core feature
recommendation.body: Accept the permanent surface after all correctness blockers, upgrade proof, and real behavior proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature and its deterministic removal both appear in this person's recent merged history, making them the strongest available owner for the product choice.
